Author: VoidWitchCult

﻿
You inherited the farm from your Mayo who will later on evaluate you to see if you right percentage of fat for your Mayo-....er....if your farm is pleasing in the eye of the Mayo god. 

[s]Do Grandpas evaluation for an extra funny.[/s]

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/L65Gx0zJ/title2-1-installation.png[/img]
﻿
 - Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
- Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
- Run the game using SMAPI.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/FzBk4Tg2/title2-1-campatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Mayo.
